L'idée est que, parce que les autres [nesciences] ne sont pas [directement] des causes du

5. Nanu vigrahato'vidyāśabdasya vidyābhinnatvaṃ vidyāśūnyatvam atyuttamavidyātvaṃ vārthaḥ
syāt, na tu viparītakhyātir ity āśāṅkyāha-- tasyāś ceti / Tasyāś cāvidyāyāḥ satattvaṃ tattvaṃ vastv
eva vijñeyaṃ na tv abhāvo'mitrāgoṣpadādiśabdavad ity arthaḥ / Dṛṣṭāntaṃ vibhajate-- yathā nāmitra
iti / Na mitrābhāva iti / Atrābhāvaśabdena saṃsargānyonyābhāvau grāhyau / Na mitramātram iti /
Nāsti mitraṃ yasmād itivyutpattyā kevalamitram ity arthaḥ / Kiṃ tu tadviruddho mitraviruddha ity
arthaḥ / Tathā ca nirūḍhalakṣaṇeti bhāvaḥ / Kiṃ tu deśa eveti / Vipulo deśaviśeṣo'goṣpada iti
